{"inp":{"code":"# Calculations for EALT4 based on provided numbers
patrim_liq = 337052000.0
vpa = 15.114439
lpa = 4.248834
preco = 14.55
div_liq = 98547000.0
ebit = 93660000.0

shares = patrim_liq / vpa
market_cap = shares * preco
ev = market_cap + div_liq
current_ev_ebit = ev / ebit

# Valuation methods
# 1) P/VP = 1x -> target price = VPA
target_pvp = vpa

# 2) EV/EBIT = 6x (conservative expansion) -> EV_target = ebit * 6 -> price target = (EV_target - net_debt)/shares
ev_target_6x = ebit * 6.0
price_ev_6x = (ev_target_6x - div_liq) / shares

# 3) EV/EBIT = 5x (more conservative) ->
ev_target_5x = ebit * 5.0
price_ev_5x = (ev_target_5x - div_liq) / shares

# 4) P/L = 6x -> price = lpa * 6
price_pl_6x = lpa * 6.0
# 5) P/L = 5x ->
price_pl_5x = lpa * 5.0
# 6) P/L = 4x ->
price_pl_4x = lpa * 4.0

# Build outputs
shares, market_cap, ev, current_ev_ebit, target_pvp, price_ev_5x, price_ev_6x, price_pl_4x, price_pl_5x, price_pl_6x
print(f"shares = {shares:.2f}")
print(f"market_cap = R${market_cap:,.2f}")
print(f"EV = R${ev:,.2f}")
print(f"current EV/EBIT = {current_ev_ebit:.2f} (calculated)")
print()
print(f"Target (P/VP=1x) = R${target_pvp:.2f}")
print(f"Target (EV/EBIT=5x) = R${price_ev_5x:.2f}")
print(f"Target (EV/EBIT=6x) = R${price_ev_6x:.2f}")
print(f"Target (P/L=4x) = R${price_pl_4x:.2f}")
print(f"Target (P/L=5x) = R${price_pl_5x:.2f}")
print(f"Target (P/L=6x) = R${price_pl_6x:.2f}")

# Compute a weighted target: conservative mix: 40% P/VP, 30% EV/EBIT(6x), 30% P/L(5x)
w_target = 0.4*target_pvp + 0.3*price_ev_6x + 0.3*price_pl_5x
print(f"\nWeighted target (40%P/VP +30%EV6x +30%P/L5x) = R${w_target:.2f}")

# Another conservative mix used previously: 35% P/VP + 35% EV/EBIT(5x) + 30% P/L(5x)
w_target2 = 0.35*target_pvp + 0.35*price_ev_5x + 0.30*price_pl_5x
print(f"Weighted target 2 (35%P/VP +35%EV5x +30%P/L5x) = R${w_target2:.2f}")

# Median of selected methods
methods = [target_pvp, price_ev_5x, price_ev_6x, price_pl_4x, price_pl_5x, price_pl_6x]
import statistics
median = statistics.median(methods)
mean = statistics.mean(methods)
print(f"Median of methods = R${median:.2f}")
print(f"Mean of methods = R${mean:.2f}")

# Upside from current price
print(f"Upside Weighted target = {(w_target - preco)/preco*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Upside Weighted target2 = {(w_target2 - preco)/preco*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Upside Median = {(median - preco)/preco*100:.1f}%")
print(f"Upside Mean = {(mean - preco)/preco*100:.1f}%")


"} }
